prompt: Under rows of blossoming fruit trees in a spring orchard, a wooden bench sits beside a winding stone pathway edged with wildflowers. Bees buzz around white petals as butterflies dance above a garden bed beside an arbor draped in vines and a wooden fence. A painted scarecrow stands near a weathered garden shed with a birdhouse perched on its corner. A robin hops along the ground near a snail inching across a stepping stone. Nearby, a wheelbarrow holds a basket of apples beside a shovel leaning against a rain barrel and a watering can. A stone fountain bubbles next to a rustic well, where a bucket rests on its rope. A wooden crate of produce lies close to a pair of gardening gloves. There is no plastic toy, no lawnmower, no metal bench, no plastic container, and no car.
